### Compelled to Compassionate Action
Author: Rachael Adams
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/compelled-to-compassionate-action-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Mark 2:3-4
Points:
- God frequently works through people who are willing to make sacrifices and put forth effort for others.
- The four men refused to let crowds or physical barriers deter them from carrying their friend to Jesus.
- Receiving physical restoration required the paralyzed man to take action in obedience to Christ's command.
- Recognizing both physical and spiritual needs in others should compel believers to bring people to Jesus.

### Forgiveness and Healing
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/forgiveness-and-healing
Passage: Mark 2:9-11
Points:
- Human suffering and physical illness are rooted in the brokenness of a fallen world.
- Reconciliation with God through the pardon of sins is humanity's most critical need.
- Jesus made a clear claim to divine identity because only God can forgive sins.
- Christ proved His invisible authority to grant forgiveness by visibly restoring the paralyzed man's body.
